<function name="GetDamageCustom" parent="CTakeDamageInfo" type="classfunc">
	<description>Gets the custom damage type. This is used by Day of Defeat: Source and Team Fortress 2 for extended damage info, but isn't used in Garry's Mod by default.</description>
	<realm>Shared</realm>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="number">The custom damage type</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
